clue.text: Looked for playful offspring outside

indicators.note: outside says the word for offspring wraps round the word for playful

parts.note: seed is a biblical word for offspring or descendants
arch means playfully mischievous, as in an arch look

explanation.surface: Someone hunted for their frolicking children, who were out of doors.
explanation.definitionFit: To have searched is to have hunted for something, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Composed some songs-composed at every opportunity

indicators.note: some says only part of the following words is used, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: A songwriter turned out music calmly whenever the chance came.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'composed at every'; 'songs' and 'opportunity' fill out the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedate means calm and unhurried, the same as composed.

clue.text: "Ben Battle was a soldier bold, and used to war's Hood" (Faithless Nelly Gray)

definitions.text: "Ben Battle was a soldier bold, and used to war's Hood" (Faithless Nelly Gray)

parts.words: "Ben Battle was a soldier bold, and used to war's Hood" (Faithless Nelly Gray)
parts.note: a fill-in-the-blank quotation: Thomas Hood's comic poem Faithless Nelly Gray ends its second line with the missing word, which rhymes with arms

explanation.walkthrough: Hood is the poet, Thomas Hood, not a missing word; the line is completed from his ballad.
explanation.definitionFit: War's alarms are its calls to arms and dangers, the phrase that completes the line.

clue.text: Taking a vehicle to move a load

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
to go is to move

explanation.surface: Using a car to shift some freight.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo is the goods carried by a ship or plane, its load.

clue.text: The waterfall

parts.note: read as a fall in the water level, the sea going out, rather than a cascade

explanation.definitionFit: An ebb tide is the falling of the sea after high water.

clue.text: Having put in an appearance, is near collapse

indicators.note: collapse says the letters of the words is near fall apart and are rebuilt

explanation.surface: Something that has just shown up is on the point of falling down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collapse' rearranges the six letters of 'is near'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that has arisen has come into being or emerged, that is, appeared.

clue.text: A good excuse to set a limit on drink

parts.note: to ration is to set a limit on supply
ale is a drink

explanation.surface: A fine pretext for restricting someone's boozing.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the reasoning behind something, a justification.

clue.text: Beginning to give voice about pastry

indicators.note: about says the word for give voice goes round the word for pastry

parts.note: to sing is to give voice
a tart is a pastry

explanation.surface: Starting to sing about a pie.
explanation.definitionFit: Starting means commencing, beginning something.

clue.text: The latter years of Einstein?

indicators.note: the question mark hints that the name is to be rearranged rather than read as a person

explanation.surface: A question about the old age of the great physicist.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark alone signals that the letters of 'Einstein' are rearranged; Einstein died at 76, so the surface sense is false.
explanation.definitionFit: A person's nineties are the decade from ninety to ninety-nine, late in life.

clue.text: Give assistance to retired folk when there's abuse

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the word for give assistance is read backwards

parts.note: to give assistance is to aid
a tribe is a people or folk

explanation.surface: Helping pensioners turns into a slanging match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' looks like it describes the folk, but it turns AID into DIA.
explanation.definitionFit: A diatribe is a bitter verbal attack, a torrent of abuse.

clue.text: Family effort

definitions.meaning: a line of descent or breed

explanation.definitionFit: Strain means both a lineage or breed and hard physical exertion.

clue.text: Bearing in dull food

indicators.note: in says the bearing sits inside the word for dull

parts.note: mat is a spelling of matt, meaning dull, not glossy
E, east, is a compass bearing

explanation.surface: Carrying something into a tedious meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Meat was once a general word for food, as in meat and drink.

clue.text: Time to get up put off

parts.note: tempo is musical time or pace
to rise is to get up

explanation.surface: A reluctant sleeper is told it is time to get out of bed.
explanation.definitionFit: To temporise is to delay or stall in order to gain time.

clue.text: A group of musicians etc to organise

indicators.note: organise says the letters of etc to are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions for arranging a band and so forth.
explanation.definitionFit: An octet is an ensemble of eight players.

clue.text: Backing Italian agreement the French are giving ground

indicators.note: backing means going in reverse, so the Italian yes is read backwards

parts.note: si is Italian for yes
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Supporting an Italian deal, the French back down.
explanation.definitionFit: An isle is a piece of land surrounded by water, so a patch of ground.

clue.text: Sound choreography!

parts.note: a dance whose steps make a noise, like clog or tap dancing, rather than well-made dance routines

explanation.definitionFit: A step dance is one in which the footwork is the display, often noisily rhythmic.

clue.text: Student writing a letter about the shower

indicators.note: about says the spelt-out letter goes round the word for the shower

parts.note: tee is the spelt-out name of the letter T
rain is a shower

explanation.surface: A pupil is penning a note about the bathroom fitting.
explanation.definitionFit: A trainee is someone learning a trade, a learner or apprentice.

clue.text: Endless praise and build-up for a certain European

indicators.note: build-up says the letters are assembled into something new
endless means the word praise loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Constant praise and hype for one individual from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endless' cuts PRAISE to PRAIS; with AND, 'build-up' rearranges PRAISAND.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spaniard is a native of Spain, one particular European nationality.

clue.text: Being stiff, got up — such a bloomer

parts.note: prim means stiffly proper
rose means got up

explanation.surface: Getting up stiffly, someone makes a howler.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' means a flowering plant, not a blunder.
explanation.definitionFit: A primrose is a pale yellow spring flower, a plant that blooms.

clue.text: Forecast the Left will retain ten

indicators.note: will retain says the word for the left holds ten inside it

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship
ten taken as written

explanation.surface: A political prediction that the Left will keep ten seats.
explanation.walkthrough: PORT is the nautical word for left.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is an omen or sign predicting what will happen.

clue.text: The charge made to ring

definitions.meaning: a fee for using a road or bridge

explanation.definitionFit: A toll is a payment levied for passage, and a bell tolls when it rings slowly.

clue.text: A troublesome creature many support

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
a leg is a support, as of a table

explanation.surface: Lots of people back a pesky animal.
explanation.definitionFit: A cleg is a horsefly, a biting insect that pesters livestock and people.

clue.text: 30 business

definitions.meaning: the cross-reference points to the solution of 30 across, meaning stake or share

explanation.definitionFit: Concern means a stake or share in something and also a firm or enterprise.

clue.text: Artist in a bistro showing bottle

indicators.note: in says the artist sits inside the word for bistro

parts.note: a cafe is a small restaurant, like a bistro
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter in a French eatery displays a wine flask.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass vessel for serving wine or water.

clue.text: We sent orders for the latest fashion

indicators.note: orders means puts in a fresh arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A request is posted for the most up-to-date styles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orders' looks like placing a purchase but rearranges 'We sent'.
explanation.definitionFit: The newest is the most recent thing, the current trend.

clue.text: The gypsy can obtain no bananas

parts.note: no taken as written
bananas is slang for mad

explanation.surface: A traveller is unable to get hold of any fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bananas' looks like fruit but is slang for crazy.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomad is a wanderer with no fixed home, like a traveller.

clue.text: Come down on unsmiling foreign prince

parts.note: to land is to come down from the air
grave means solemn, unsmiling

explanation.surface: Someone is told to come down hard on a stern-faced visiting royal.
explanation.definitionFit: A landgrave was a German count with territorial jurisdiction, a princely ruler.

clue.text: Not all blackleg rebels will get the bird

indicators.note: Not all says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Strike-breakers who rebel will be jeered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'get the bird' is to be booed, but here it simply names a waterbird.
explanation.definitionFit: A grebe is a diving waterbird, so a bird in the literal sense.

clue.text: A spring flood

parts.note: a bound is a leap or spring

explanation.surface: A spring overflowing with water.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flood' is a verb here: to be present in great numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: To abound is to be plentiful, to teem or pour in great numbers.

clue.text: Purchase pounds, always mature

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling
ever means always
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: Buying with money that always grows older.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Purchase' here means a grip or mechanical advantage, not buying.
explanation.definitionFit: Purchase is a firm hold or mechanical advantage, the same as leverage.

clue.text: Discourage assimilating one faster

indicators.note: assimilating means taking in, so the word for discourage absorbs the numeral

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Putting someone off by absorbing a speedier person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'faster' is one who fasts, not something quicker.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who fasts restricts their food, which is what a person on a diet does.

clue.text: Profit from intrigue

definitions.meaning: the return earned on money lent
to intrigue is to arouse curiosity

explanation.definitionFit: Interest is money earned on capital, and to arouse curiosity in someone is to intrigue them.
